title: GREAT KING OF ALL BY KOREDE AND

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: From the depth of my heart
Lord, I sing of Your awesomeness
You are more than words can say
Heaven and earth, You called to be

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Power and might belong to You
Glory and strength are in Your dwelling place
Splendour and grace are before You, Lord
Honour and wealth come from You

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Great King of all, God of all flesh
Creator of all, we glorify You
